title: 1957 By Love Possessed by James Gould Cozzens - Hardcover Book
descriptionText:
This 1957 novel, titled "By Love Possessed" and written by James Gould Cozzens, is a vintage hardcover book published by Harcourt Brace. The book is in its original English language and is a first edition. The narrative type of the book is fiction and it falls under the genres of adult and erotic romance. 

The book talks about the topic of romance and erotica, making it a perfect choice for those who are interested in such themes. The author, James Gould Cozzens, has crafted a story that will keep readers captivated till the very end. This book is a must-have for any book collector or anyone who is looking for a classic piece of literature.
